_doc: Ratchet bounds for tests/test_universality.py. generative_share is a floor (the
ablated graph must reproduce at least this share of the canonical ground truth);
residual, observed_fires and shallow are ceilings. Loosening any of them is a
deliberate, reviewable diff line, not a side effect of a refactor.
recover_s is the measured _observe+_graph wall clock, so CI cost stays visible.

baseline.jitter: none: every figure below reproduced exactly on two independent runs, so the bounds sit at the measured value with no margin

tunes.frames_why: 400 is where each structure recurs rather than happening once: orderlist cursor $54EC takes 3 values (2 advances), pattern cursor $54EF resets twice, and the $10 pulse ramp runs segments of up to 24 emits at step 22 over bound 256 (2 full turns). At 200 each of the three occurs exactly once; the full tune's 11750 frames is ~160s and far too slow for CI
a second engine at the same frame count; mid-range share, so movement in either direction is visible where Commando's 0.92 has little room left
